WITH ranked_dungeons AS ( SELECT d.id, d.title, s.sido_name AS region, g.gugun_name AS city, d.start_date, d.end_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY q.id) AS rn FROM user u JOIN party_member pm ON u.id = pm.user_id JOIN party p ON p.id = pm.party_id JOIN dungeon d ON p.dungeon_id = d.id LEFT JOIN quest q ON q.dungeon_id = d.id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON a.no = q.attraction_id LEFT JOIN sidos s ON a.area_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN guguns g ON a.si_gun_gu_code = g.gugun_code AND a.area_code = g.sido_code WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' -- ✅ 파티 완료 상태 필터 추가 ) SELECT * FROM ranked_dungeons WHERE rn = 1
